markets.rules_primary: If Miami or Minnesota record at least 1 defensive or special teams touchdown in the Miami vs Minnesota Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 4, 2026, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
This market resolves based on whether either team records a defensive or special teams touchdown in the Miami vs Minnesota Pro Football game originally scheduled for Oct 4, 2026. Defensive or special teams touchdowns recorded in overtime count. If the game is postponed but begins within 48 hours of its originally scheduled start time, the market will remain open and resolve based on the official final result. If the game is not started within 48 hours, the market will resolve to a fair price.
